content: A balanced diet provides the body with different nutrients including carbohydrates, proteins, healthy fats, vitamins, minerals, fiber and water. Eating a variety of fruits, vegetables, whole grains, legumes, nuts and other nutritious foods can help support overall health.

Sleep is important for physical restoration, memory, learning, mood and normal immune function. Maintaining a consistent sleep schedule and having a comfortable sleep environment can support healthy sleep habits.

Water is essential for many body functions, including temperature regulation, digestion and transportation of nutrients. Fluid needs vary depending on factors such as activity, environment and individual circumstances.
Regular physical activity supports cardiovascular health, muscle and bone strength, mood and overall wellbeing. Different types of activity can provide different benefits.

Washing hands with soap and water helps remove germs and can reduce the spread of infections. Important times to wash hands include before eating and after using the toilet or being around potentially contaminated surfaces.
